notes: Profile cases: 40 steps skip10; throughput: 80 skip10, two seeds. Short performance diagnostics, not convergence tests.
No-recompute uncropped 60kx100 warmup OOM; all valid uncropped comparisons enable recompute in both crop arms.
ShapePrior bypasses graphs/filters and uses requested widths. It does not hold actual GPU work exactly constant.
Shared cache affects startup/wall comparisons; CUDA-event stage intervals include CPU submission gaps and DDP tail.
Cohort K=1 preserves single-table shape law but changes within-step correlation and gradient noise.
16 real Gloo processes validate small-model gradients only; physical GPU performance tested on eight devices.
